steps.content: The shackles tear through the oppressive gloom, plunging the alley back into silence. The haunting whispers have vanished; even the wind has stilled.
The report indicated that the M-Value near Désir was approaching disaster range. Yet the contamination you felt just now was mild compared to that... There must be something more.
A clear, sweet greeting interrupts the silence. A blonde girl is standing just beyond the shadows.
Betwixt the silent valley and veiled sky, a ray of sunlight falls upon the girl, its golden hue so soft it seems to envelop her in a gossamer veil, lending an ethereal quality to her presence.
She repeats, her tone calm yet unsettlingly similar to the whispers you've since heard.
